note: One row per family of unbound Lua names in tools/lua_api_scan/baseline.json: a family is the names of one host and kind that share a stem (the part before the first dot or underscore). tests/inventory/test_lua_gap_plan.py fails when a baseline name has no row here or a row names something the baseline no longer lists. When a binding fix drops a name from the baseline, drop it from its row (and the row when it empties, renumbering order) in the same change. Order inside owner_lane: severity first (critical = load or start of a script, high = recurring), then score = the sum over the family's names of call sites x mods blocked, highest first. severity, call_sites and mods_blocked (the most mods blocked by any name of the family) come from the scan matrix (python -m tools.lua_api_scan --out-dir, matrix.json, run 2026-11-23 over stock and the nine mod profiles); they are a snapshot, so re-rank from a fresh scan when the next family is picked up.
